questions.q: Protecting the environment is a Fundamental Duty under:
questions.explanation: **51A(g)**; Article 48A is the Directive Principle on the environment.

questions.q: How many States have a Legislative Council?
questions.explanation: **Six**: Maharashtra, U.P., Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka.

questions.q:
Consider the following about Legislative Councils:
1. Parliament creates or abolishes a Council by ordinary law under Article 169.
2. The State Assembly must first pass a resolution by a two-thirds majority.
Which is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both are correct; such a law is **not** treated as a constitutional amendment under Article 368.

questions.q: What share of a Legislative Council's members are elected by graduates?
questions.explanation: **1/12** by graduates and 1/12 by teachers; 1/3 by local bodies, 1/3 by MLAs, 1/6 nominated.

questions.q: A member of a Legislative Council serves a term of:
questions.explanation: **6 years**; one-third retire every 2 years. The Council is never dissolved.

questions.q: On a Money Bill, a Legislative Council can:
options: Send it to a joint sitting
questions.explanation: It can only **recommend** within **14 days** (Article 198).

questions.q: Bicameral legislatures in six provinces were created by the:
questions.explanation: The **GoI Act, 1935**.

questions.q: Tamil Nadu's Legislative Council was abolished in 1986 when the CM was:
questions.explanation: **MGR**. Andhra Pradesh abolished its Council in 1985 (NTR) and re-created it in 2007.

questions.q: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) replaced which law from 1 July 2024?
questions.explanation: The **CrPC, 1973**. BNS replaced the IPC; BSA the Evidence Act.

questions.q: VB-G RAM G, which replaced MGNREGA in 2026, stands for:
options: Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
Vikas Bharat Gram Rozgar Abhiyan Mission Grameen
Viksit Bharat Gramin Rozgar Aur Majdoori
Vishwas Bharat Guarantee for Rural Assets Mission
questions.explanation: **Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)**, under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.

questions.q: How many questions does Census 2027 have?
questions.explanation: **40** questions (13 new); India's first digital census.

questions.q: Who is the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**.

questions.q: In Census 2027's caste question, which statement is correct?
options: Caste is asked only of SCs and STs
There is a separate OBC column
questions.explanation: SC/ST pick from a list; **others type their caste**; there is no separate OBC column; Aadhaar is optional.

questions.q: 'Census' is a subject in which list, and which law governs it?
options: State List; Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
questions.explanation: **Union List, Entry 69**; the **Census Act, 1948**.

questions.q: The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025 merged how many older laws?
questions.explanation: **Four** older laws.

questions.q: In a Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), a reading above 50 indicates:
questions.explanation: **Expansion**. India's manufacturing PMI was 54.7 in October.

questions.q: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced the:
questions.explanation: The **Aircraft Act, 1934**. New fare rules under it were notified on 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026 was held at:
questions.explanation: **Bharat Mandapam**, New Delhi, 2-5 Nov.

questions.q: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan) in Delhi-NCR is run by:
questions.explanation: The **Commission for Air Quality Management**; GRAP has four stages.

questions.q: The precautionary and polluter-pays principles were set out in the:
questions.explanation: The **Rio Declaration (1992)**.

questions.q: The Siang Upper Multipurpose Project is in:
questions.explanation: **Arunachal Pradesh**, planned at 11.2 GW. The Yarlung Tsangpo becomes the Brahmaputra.

questions.q: Cyclone Murasu made landfall in Nov 2026 in which State?
questions.explanation: **Andhra Pradesh**, between Ongole and Nellore.

questions.q: Who is Iran's Foreign Minister (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Abbas Araghchi**; Esmaeil Baqaei is the spokesman.

questions.q: Israel's Knesset has how many seats?
questions.explanation: **120**; 61 for a majority; 3.25% threshold.

questions.q: India's relationship with Vietnam is classed as a:
questions.explanation: **Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**. NSA Ajit Doval held talks in Hanoi.

questions.q: Contracts for 8 Next Generation Corvettes were split between GRSE and which shipyard?
questions.explanation: **GRSE** builds 5 and **Goa Shipyard** 3 (₹53,866.50 crore).

questions.q: The 2026 Kavli Prize in astrophysics was for discovering:
options: Past mergers of the Milky Way
questions.explanation: Belokurov, Helmi and Ibata found the **Milky Way's past galaxy mergers**.

questions.q: Which spacecraft carried Laika, the first animal to orbit Earth?
questions.explanation: **Sputnik 2**, launched 3 Nov 1957.

questions.q: The first probe to Mercury was:
questions.explanation: **Mariner 10**, launched 3 Nov 1973.

questions.q: Forced labour is prohibited by which Article?
questions.explanation: **Article 23**; law: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976.

questions.q: Who is the Solicitor-General of India (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Tushar Mehta**; R. Venkataramani is Attorney General.

questions.q: The Statue of Unity, inaugurated in 2018, is how tall?
questions.explanation: **182 m**, at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat.

questions.q: Who became the youngest Formula One world champion in 2026?
questions.explanation: **Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes, Italy), at 20 years 68 days.

questions.q: Before Antonelli, the last Italian F1 world champion was:
questions.explanation: **Alberto Ascari** (1953). Previous youngest champion: Sebastian Vettel.

questions.q: Which Australian all-rounder retired from international cricket in Nov 2026?
questions.explanation: **Glenn Maxwell**: 7 Tests, 149 ODIs, 130 T20Is.

questions.q: The Second Administrative Reforms Commission (2007) suggested turning Legislative Councils into:
options: Elected upper houses with money powers
questions.explanation: **Councils of local governments**, elected by local body members.

questions.q: Under the Tenth Schedule, an independent member who joins a party after the election:
questions.explanation: Para 2(2): he is **disqualified**; the Presiding Officer decides.

questions.q: Section 163 of the BNSS (prohibitory orders) replaces which CrPC section?
questions.explanation: Old **Section 144**.

questions.q: State Election Commissions are constitutional bodies under:
questions.explanation: **243K** (panchayats) and **243ZA** (municipalities).

questions.q: The NDRF is a statutory force under the:
questions.explanation: The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**.
